item.subject: maths
item.stem: Ira cuts a paper rectangle into pieces $P$ and $Q$ and rearranges them into a new outline with no gaps and no overlaps. The diagram shows the original rectangle and the rearranged outline.

options.A: The new outline must have smaller area because its outer path looks different.
options.B: Equal area is what forces the rearranged outline to be a rectangle again.
options.C: The rearranged outline has the same area as the original rectangle.
options.D: Area stays equal even if she throws piece $Q$ away before rearranging.
